The BJP's own internal surveys also indicate that the path ahead for the party in UP will not be easy this time. The greatest concern lies with Purvanchal, the region from which most of the NDA’s allies hail; meanwhile, the RLD’s Jayant Chaudhary will also seek a number of seats that he deems respectable. This time, the BJP has gained two additional allies; besides the RLD, OP Rajbhar’s party also joined the NDA following the last election.
